rows.grounds: absolutive of ā-nī with compound object gṛha-abhyantara; indicates prior action of bringing inside the house
causative optative prescribing the subsequent ritual action
locative compound/adverbial phrase specifying the place of installation

items.question: Where must the ritually bathed deity be installed after being brought inside the house?
premises: The deity has been brought into the interior of the house.
A prescribed action of placement follows this bringing.
The designated location for placement is upon a seat.
items.inference: After being brought inside the house, the bathed deity should be placed upon a seat.
items.plain_english: Having brought it inside the house, one should place it upon the seat.
